# Browsershot

> Browsershot is a free, open-source command-line tool for capturing web pages and browser state. It helps developers and coding agents visually inspect and verify web interfaces.

It can capture screenshots of pages or elements, interact with pages, inspect elements, collect browser errors, and produce JSON for scripts and agents. It also supports authenticated captures, HTML output, and video recording.
